description: Does nicotine replacement therapy (any form: patch, gum, lozenge, inhaler, nasal or mouth spray, sublingual tablet) help adults who smoke tobacco to stop smoking, compared with placebo or no NRT? A second question compares combination NRT (patch plus a fast-acting form) with a single form. Primary outcome: abstinence at six months or longer, biochemically validated where possible; secondary: serious adverse events and withdrawal due to adverse events. Randomized or quasi-randomized controlled trials only. Any language, no date limits.
